systems.country_label: Physical Persons National Register (RNPP)/National Identity Card; the Carte « C'est Moi » as foundational credential
systems.tiers: national; the 2024 Findex round asked about the old Carte nationale d'identité, so Benin's foundational coverage rests on 2021 data
Benin is one of four Sub-Saharan economies coded as giving access to a digital ID system at data collection in 2024

note: A global identity-coverage dataset; for Benin it gives only the names of the identity credentials and a coding note, and nothing on civil registration offices or on Benin's birth registration.
